Define who moves together in household transitions

Source: R/group_transition.R
household.Rd

Define a set of rules for determining household membership for transitions.

Usage

household(age_independence = 18)

Arguments

age_independence

Age in years at which a child stops being a dependent: below it, an unpartnered child with a living parent is a dependent. Defaults to 18.

Value

A hammel_household, to pass as household to set_group_transition(). Each transition process may use its own rule.

Details

A household rule describes a household for set_group_transition(). The simulation does not track households independently, but determines who belongs to a household when a household would move and assembles the moving party.

A person's household is their current partner (married or cohabiting) and the dependents attached to either of them. A dependent is alive, unpartnered, younger than age_independence, and attached to their mother while she is alive, otherwise to their father while he is alive. People with neither parent alive are independent. A person under age_independence who leaves a union is a dependent again if a parent is alive.

Examples

household(age_independence = 18)
#> $age_independence
#> [1] 18
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "hammel_household"
